credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Per Tish Frank, Eliot Porter would take his camera and wooden tripod and his sons would go along on trips to carry equipment.  This photograph is from the Glen Canyon Album that Todd Webb gave to Georgia O'Keeffe 'in memory of the great August 1961 trip down the Colorado River.'
title: Carrying Photographic Equipment Through Canyon
